authority: Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science 9618 syllabus for exams in 2026, Version 2
rule: Additive only. Existing internal LO codes are not renumbered or rewritten. componentNumbers are explicit so classifier coverage is written with each added LO.

learningObjectives.text: Understand and define the functions of NOT, AND, OR, NAND, NOR and XOR (EOR) gates
Show appreciation of the need for both the security of data and the security of the computer system

Write pseudocode statements for: the declaration and initialisation of constants; the declaration of variables; the assignment of values to variables; expressions involving arithmetic or logical operators; input from the keyboard; output to the console
Use built-in functions and library routines
Justify why one loop structure may be better suited to solve a problem than the others
Explain where in the construction of an algorithm it would be appropriate to use a procedure
Explain where in the construction of an algorithm it is appropriate to use a function
Locate and identify the different types of errors
Show understanding that binary representations can give rise to rounding errors
Understanding what is meant by a programming paradigm
